sentences.en: The company embossed the logo on the new product.
sentences.zh: 公司把logo压印在新产品上了。

sentences.en: She carefully embossed her name on the invitation card.
sentences.zh: 她仔细地在请柬上压出了自己的名字。

sentences.en: The artist embossed a relief sculpture using clay.
sentences.zh: 艺术家用黏土浮雕塑造了一件雕刻作品。

senses.zh: 使凸出；在……上作浮雕图案；装饰
